newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean industrial output falls in March - Sofofa.
newsitem.headline: Chilean industrial output falls in March - Sofofa.

text.p: Chilean industrial production fell sharply in March over the same month last year and slipped 0.3 percent in the first quarter, the business organization Sociedad de Fomento Fabril (Sofofa) said.

In a battery of figures all pointing to a slowdown in growth, Sofofa said industrial production in March tumbled 3.6 percent in March over the same month last year and sales of industrial products fell 0.7 percent in March.

Industrial output in the first quarter of the year fell 0.3 percent over the same quarter of last year, but modest increases early in the year helped push industrial sales up three percent in the first quarter over the same period of 1996, said Sofofa.

The figures were the lastest sign that the Chilean economy's growth was still sluggish, despite a Central Bank interest rate cut. In the most recent official growth figures, the economy grew a weak 2.9 percent in February.
